description: This file implements the CertNetFetcher URL request handling in Chromium, managing network fetch requests, request lifecycle, threading, and de-duplication logic for certificate-related network fetches.

classes.name: CertNetFetcherURLRequest
classes.description: Main class managing certificate network fetch requests, threading, and request lifecycle.

classes.name: CertNetFetcherURLRequest::RequestCore
classes.description: Reference-counted class representing an individual fetch request, handling completion, cancellation, and error signaling.

classes.name: CertNetFetcherURLRequest::RequestParams
classes.description: Structure holding parameters for a fetch request, including URL, HTTP method, response size limit, and timeout.

classes.name: CertNetFetcherURLRequest::AsyncCertNetFetcherURLRequest
classes.description: Manages asynchronous URL requests, de-duplication, and timeouts, operating on the network thread.

classes.name: Job
classes.description: Represents an active URL request, manages request lifecycle, response reading, and notifies attached requests upon completion.

methods.name: CertNetFetcherURLRequest::FetchCaIssuers
methods.description: Initiates a fetch request for CA issuer URLs with specified timeout and response size limit.

methods.name: CertNetFetcherURLRequest::FetchCrl
methods.description: Initiates a fetch request for CRL URLs with specified timeout and response size limit.

methods.name: CertNetFetcherURLRequest::FetchOcsp
methods.description: Initiates a fetch request for OCSP URLs with specified timeout and response size limit.

methods.name: CertNetFetcherURLRequest::SetURLRequestContext
methods.description: Sets the URLRequestContext used for network requests.

methods.name: CertNetFetcherURLRequest::Shutdown
methods.description: Shuts down the fetcher, cancelling ongoing requests and cleaning up.

methods.name: CertNetFetcherURLRequest::GetDefaultTimeoutForTesting
methods.description: Returns the default timeout duration used for testing.

methods.name: RequestCore::CancelJob
methods.description: Cancels the ongoing request, signals immediate error.

methods.name: RequestCore::SignalImmediateError
methods.description: Signals an immediate error for the request, typically used for cancellation.

methods.name: Job::StartURLRequest
methods.description: Creates and starts the URLRequest, sets up request parameters, and initiates network fetch.

methods.name: Job::OnResponseStarted
methods.description: Handles the start of the URL response, checks response code, and begins reading body.

methods.name: Job::OnReadCompleted
methods.description: Handles completion of a read operation, continues reading if needed.

methods.name: Job::OnUrlRequestCompleted
methods.description: Handles completion of URLRequest, triggers final processing.

methods.name: Job::OnJobCompleted
methods.description: Finalizes the job, stops timers, and notifies attached requests.
